title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Plan International Ireland SQRIBE programme is located across seven locations across Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Burkina Faso, Mali, Central African Republic, and Cameroon. The intended outcome is that Vulnerable and Marginalised Children Realise their Rights to Access and Benefit from a Safe, Quality, Resilient and Inclusion-Based Education (SQRIBE). The objective of the grant is to meet [urgent] education and protection needs for children. The key activities include financial and technical support to schools and vocational centres, community sensitisation and mobilisation in relation to child rights, in particular girls’ rights, and capacity building for education stakeholders. The programme is delivered in partnership with local partners.OBJECTIVES: Objective 4.1: Strengthened capacities of MOE & in-country education stakeholders; crisis sensitive & gender responsive education planning guidelines OUTCOMES: Outcome 4: Education systems are better prepared to respond and mitigate the risks of disasters, conflict and violence.
